'''Morana''' (Japanese: '''ドラゴ''' ''Drago'') a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]''. She is a dojo breaker from the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]] who [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Ice}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. She is the final character of the day to appear in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]''.

Morana visited the [[Striaton Gym]], though she did not wish to acquire the {{Badge|Trio}}. Instead, when confronted by [[Chili]] and [[Cress]], she challenged them to a {{pkmn|battle}}, with the status of their [[Gym]] at stake. Initially, the brothers were reluctant, but they soon decided to accept her challenge after she insulted Cress. She defeated Chili and Cress in short order, but then learned that she had to defeat {{an|Cilan}}, the third [[Gym Leader]], to fully defeat the Gym.

With that knowledge, Morana traveled to [[Paladin Island]] in the [[Decolore Islands]], as did Chili and Cress, to meet up with Cilan. After Cilan learned all about the events that had played out, he accepted Morana's challenge and decided to use his {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}}, as it was his closest partner. She used her {{p|Abomasnow}} and took an early lead in the battle. However, during the battle, Cilan performed an evaluation on Morana's relationship with Abomasnow, in which he concluded that she put victory in battle above all else, even her relationship with her Pokémon. After confirming his evaluation, Morana tried to overpower Cilan and win, but Cilan and Pansage overwhelmed her using a tactical attack. She bitterly admitted defeat and swore that she would defeat Cilan the next time they met.
